items.snippet:
Does eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04) work for moms with elastic nipples?
Yes, eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04) is designed with moms who have elastic nipples in mind, by providing a flange tunnel that is fit and long enough to accommodate the stretch.

What flange size does my Breast Pump S1 Pro (T8D04) come with?
The Breast Pump S1 Pro (T8D04) comes with a 24mm flange as standard, and a 27mm flange can be purchased separately.

Can I return my Breast Pump S1 Pro (T8D04)?
Yes, you can return the Breast Pump S1 Pro (T8D04) if it meets the following conditions: As a medical and personal hygiene device, returns are accepted only if the item is in its new, unopened state with intact seals, unused, and in its original packaging within 30 days of purchase. How can I get replacement accessories for my Breast Pump S1 Pro (T8D04)?
You can purchase official replacement parts compatible with the S1 Pro. Available replacement accessories include: - 24mm Breast Shield x2 (SKU: T8D02181-82) - Milk Container x2 (SKU: T8D02181-83) - 21mm Size Insert x2 (SKU: T8D02181-84) - 19mm Size Insert x2 (SKU: T8D02181-85) - 17mm Size Insert x2 (SKU: T8D02181-86) - 15mm

What suction level is right for eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04)?
The right suction level for eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04) is the maximum level that still feels comfortable to you.

What is the warranty policy for the Breast Pump S1 Pro (T8D04)?
1. The pump hub has a 1-year warranty.
2. Washable parts have a 3-month warranty.

Is eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04) HSA/FSA eligible?
Yes, eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04) is HSA/FSA eligible on Amazon.

How do I control eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04)?
eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04) is controlled via the buttons on the pump hub: - Power button: Press and hold to turn on/off. - Mode button: Switch between stimulation mode and expression mode. - + / - buttons: Adjust suction level. Please refer to the product manual or in-app guide for full button function details and LED indicator

What is the Pump Flow Curve feature on eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04)?
The Pump Flow Curve on eufy Wearable Breast Pump S1 Pro(T8D04) is a graphical representation of the intensity and duration of the suction cycle. 1. Check the flange insert size for each breast using the nipple measurement card, as different sizes may be needed for each side.
2. Verify the wearing position: the nipple should be centered in the flange tunnel and the pump should fit snugly against the breast.
